---
title: Contribute to a handbook
subtitle: "Corrections and proposals, in the book's own repository"
---

```{=html}
<p class="guide-lead">Every handbook accepts corrections and proposals where its manuscript lives. You do not need to know the review process: the forms ask for what a maintainer needs.</p>
<p class="actions"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="index.html#library">Pick a handbook</a><a class="btn btn-outline-primary" href="https://github.com/cesarcastrocuba/handbooks-hub">Improve the platform</a></p>

<p class="section-kicker">Four steps</p>
<h2>From a typo to the next edition.</h2>
<ol class="pipeline">
<li><span class="step-title">Find the page</span><span class="step-text">Open the handbook's reading site and follow its link to the source repository or to <em>Report an issue</em>.</span><span class="step-meta">Reader</span></li>
<li><span class="step-title">Tell or propose</span><span class="step-text">Open an issue with the correction or proposal form, or send a pull request with the change.</span><span class="step-meta">You</span></li>
<li><span class="step-title">Checks and review</span><span class="step-text">The book's checks run on your pull request, and a maintainer reviews it.</span><span class="step-meta">Automatic and maintainer</span></li>
<li><span class="step-title">Next release</span><span class="step-text">Accepted changes appear in the next release of the book, and then in this library.</span><span class="step-meta">Maintainer</span></li>
</ol>

<div class="guide-note"><strong>Improve the platform itself.</strong> The toolkit, the template and this library live in the <a href="https://github.com/cesarcastrocuba/handbooks-hub">hub repository</a>. Issues and pull requests are welcome there.</div>
```
